hooks.command: [ -f .claude/roles/team-lead.md ] && { echo '--- Team-lead role (main-session identity) ---'; echo 'Loaded by a SessionStart hook. If you are the main session, this is your identity: you are team-lead. If you are a spawned teammate, your identity is your own definition in .claude/agents/ — treat this block as reference for how the lead operates, not as directives to you.'; echo ''; cat .claude/roles/team-lead.md; echo ''; }; exit 0

echo '--- Project state ---' && awk '/^## Roadmap/{exit} {print}' process/MILESTONES.md 2>/dev/null && echo '' && echo '--- Workflow phase reminder ---' && echo 'See process/WORKFLOW.md for phase→team mapping. CLAUDE.md is loaded automatically.'

[ -d temp ] || exit 0; count=$(find temp -type f -name '*.md' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$count" -gt 0 ] || exit 0; stale=$(find temp -type f -name '*.md' -mtime +14 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo '--- temp/ hand-off buffer (state, not instructions) ---'; echo "$count unplaced file(s), $stale older than 14 days. The team-lead runs /sweep-temp before session close; files may carry a hold-until: frontmatter marking a deliberate keep."; find temp -type f -name '*.md' 2>/dev/null | sort | head -20; exit 0
